# Client wave 22 (w22data), point 64: what each skill is good at. Made by client/tools/w22/build_skill_tags.py from rAthena (e985006):
# db/re/skill_db.yml, skill_tree.yml, status.yml and src/map (skills/**, battle.cpp, status.cpp). Do not edit: change the rules and rebuild.
# Read by Game/SkillTags.cs. Loki's own data: skill ids, rAthena's skill constants (for reading the table) and Loki's tag ids.
#
# T rows: a tag.    T <tab> id <tab> name
# S rows: a skill.  S <tab> id <tab> rAthena constant <tab> kind <tab> tag ids, the most characteristic first <tab> why (one per tag)
#
# KIND (what the tree's hover diorama plays), the first that fits:
#   Passive     no TargetType                       Trap      Flags IsTrap / TargetType Trap
#   Summon      its class spawns a unit             Movement  no damage, its class moves the user (or a knockback on the user)
#   GroundArea  TargetType Ground                   Heal      no damage, its class gives HP or revives
#   SelfArea    TargetType Self that attacks, a song / ensemble / chorus, or an area with a bad status
#   Buff        TargetType Self / Support, no damage, with a status      Debuff  TargetType Attack, no damage, with a status
#   Bolt        a Magic attack on one target        Projectile  a Weapon / Misc attack with a bow / gun / instrument / whip, ammunition or range >= 4
#   MeleeHit    the other attacks                   Other     nothing above
# TAGS, each with its weight (the three heaviest are kept; "All-Rounder" takes the third place when the tags span three of the
# families damage / control / protect / move / boost):
#   Area Damage 85        an attack (no NoDamage flag, Type Weapon / Magic / Misc) with a Splash flag, a SplashArea or a multi-cell unit
#   Single Target Burst 80  an attack on one target that is gated: cast + fixed cast + max(after-cast delay, cooldown) >= 2000 ms at the
#                         last level, or 5 or more hits, or it costs spirit spheres / HP rate / AP
#   Sustained 65          an attack on one target that is not gated (under 2000 ms); 40 for an area attack without a unit under 2000 ms;
#                         a passive that adds damage to every hit (the lines that ask for its level)
#   DoT 85 / 60           it gives a status that takes HP again and again (status.cpp status_change_timer; status.yml Opt2 Poison /
#                         Dpoison / Bleeding, Opt1 Burning), or a damaging enemy unit that stays 8 s or more
#   Area CC / Single Target CC 88-86 / 70-55   it gives an enemy a status that stops moving / casting / attacking (status.yml States,
#                         Opt1) or slows (a Debuff with CalcFlags Speed), on an area / on one target; 45: a knockback of 2 cells or more
#   Debuff 72 / 50        another bad status on an enemy (status.yml Flags Debuff, Opt2), or any status given by a no-damage skill aimed at an enemy
#   Heal 95-88            its class (or its unit) gives HP, revives, or its status gives HP over time
#   Shield 90             its status stops or absorbs whole hits (battle.cpp battle_status_block_damage)
#   Evasion 83 / 62       its status hides the user (status.yml Options Hide / Cloak / ChaseWalk / Invisible) or is a chance to avoid a hit
#                         (battle_status_block_damage's dodges), or raises Flee
#   Elemental Resist 82   its status raises an elemental resistance (status.cpp subele, status.yml bSubEle) or changes the armour's
#                         element (CalcFlags Def_Ele), or is an elemental immunity
#   Survivability 78      its status cuts the damage taken (battle.cpp battle_calc_damage) or changes Def / Mdef / MaxHp / Regen / Res / Mres
#   Mobility 84 / 60      its class moves the user (unit_movepos, pc_setpos, a warp), a warp unit, or its status changes the speed
#   Buff 70 / 55          its status changes an attack stat (CalcFlags Batk / Watk / Matk / Aspd / Cri / Hit / a base stat ...), or any other
#                         good status
#   Sure Hit 50           an attack that cannot miss or be reduced: DamageFlags IgnoreFlee (not Magic) / IgnoreDefense, Type Misc, or its
#                         class raises its hit rate; a passive that raises Hit
#   Support 75-45         works on allies (TargetType Support, PartyOnly / GuildOnly, a party call in its class, a friendly unit, a
#                         song); removes bad statuses; gives SP
#   Specialist 40         needs a state (Requires State: a shield, a mount, a cart ...), a status (Requires Status) or a weapon type
#                         that under half of its job's own attack skills share; an ensemble (needs a partner); a mastery for one weapon / race
#   Utility 30            none of the above (trade, crafting, looking, storing ...)
#   All-Rounder 35        see above
